Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: ITAS (Integrated Tax Administration System) rollout was expected to conclude in September 2025 per World Bank ISR (May 2025). The system is being supported under PAFEN additional financing for PFM modernization. No evidence of ITAS being integrated with a broader interoperability framework.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original single World Bank ISR source (May 2025) confirmed and updated: the tax revenue system (OBR's ITAS/e-KORI, financed under PAFEN) is no longer merely 'planned' — OBR officially launched the e-KORI implementation phase on 19 January 2026 (Burundi Times) and a 27-month change-management rollout began 25 February 2026 (OBR official site), so the system is now under active development/rollout. No evidence found of e-KORI's integration with a broader cross-government data exchange/interoperability platform, so value code revised from 2 (Planned) to 3 (Under development) rather than higher.
